name: odin-claude-plugin
title_zh: 先画图再写码，46 个 Agent 替你守住架构不跑
tagline_zh: 受够了代码和设计图各说各话？这套插件让 Claude Code 先画架构图再动手，改代码前先改图。
tagline_en: Tired of code drifting from the diagram? This plugin makes Claude Code draw first, edit via AST, and commit.
desc_en: Outline-Driven Development for Claude Code - 46 agents, 25+ skills, diagram-first methodology, AST-based editing, atomic commits.
why_zh: 别的 Skill 只改文件，它先改图再改码——用图当唯一事实源，每个 Agent 都认同一张蓝图。
why_en: Unlike skills that just edit files, this one treats the diagram as the single source of truth—every agent checks the same.
limit_zh: 只适配 Claude Code 环境，需先装好官方 CLI 并配置好 AST 编辑权限；25+ 个 Skill 偏重架。
limit_en: Claude Code CLI only; requires AST edit permissions. Geared to architecture/refactor—overkill for quick prototypes. You must draw diagrams first, or.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
